title: iOS tree finds 0 elements with several simulators — driver port 22087 conflict
symptom: With two or more simulators booted, app tree · tap return ui_dump_failed (count 0), or read another simulator's screen elements
cause: The Maestro iOS driver (XCTest runner) always uses host port 22087. If a driver for another simulator (including other sessions) holds that port, this device's driver cannot start or attaches to the wrong device
fix: Find the process holding the port with lsof -nP -iTCP:22087 -sTCP:LISTEN, and check which UDID's driver it is with ps -p <PID> -o command=
If another session's driver holds it, do not kill it — wait for that work to finish or ask the user (Maestro drives one simulator at a time)
If pro-launch left the driver behind, clean it up with launch_cli.py app session stop --device <that UDID> --kill-stale
Then check that launch_cli.py app tree --device <UDID> reads elements; to keep driving, run app session start --device <UDID>
